Its inspected membership may contain only the four exact role IDs. Running selected-container NetworkID, EndpointID and IP must agree with actual network inspection; addresses must be nonempty and unique. Wrong configured or selected network, foreign membership or populated wrong stopped NetworkID denies.
normal_lifecycle_policy.dynamic_metadata: Stopped roles may have missing network attachments or blank/missing runtime IPs. IP, endpoint/sandbox, PID and StartedAt changes are observations, not invariant hashes. Peers to stopped roles may disappear normally; no peer set is fabricated. Running roles still require real PID-owned sockets, source-shaped readiness and actual expected peers. Starts require a changed StartedAt and two fresh transition/readiness/peer samples. The final stage requires all four roles healthy and connected.
normal_lifecycle_policy.failures: Real command timeout, nonzero status, unconfirmed transition, fresh identity drift or database lifetime drift stops the sequence. Physical flock exclusion was exercised on synthetic lock files; kernel process exit is still not persistent exclusion after a standalone CLI exits.
